138static uint8_t a_wm8978_iic_read(wm8978_handle_t *handle, uint8_t reg, uint16_t *config)
139{
140 if (reg > 57) /* check range 57 */
141 {
142 *config = 0x0000; /* init 0 */
143
144 return 1; /* return error */
145 }
146 else
147 {
148 *config = handle->reg[reg]; /* get register config */
149
150 return 0; /* success return 0 */
151 }
152}

164static uint8_t a_wm8978_iic_write(wm8978_handle_t *handle, uint8_t reg, uint16_t config)
165{
166 uint8_t buf[1];
167
168 if (reg > 57) /* check range 57 */
169 {
170 return 1; /* return error */
171 }
172
173 buf[0] = config & 0xFF; /* set LSB */
174 if (handle->iic_write(WM8978_ADDRESS,
175 (reg << 1) | ((config >> 8) & 0x01), (uint8_t *)buf, 1) != 0) /* write data */
176 {
177 return 1; /* return error */
178 }
179 handle->reg[reg] = config; /* save the config */
180
181 return 0; /* success return 0 */
182}

194uint8_t wm8978_soft_reset(wm8978_handle_t *handle)
195{
196 uint8_t res;
197 uint8_t i;
198 uint16_t conf;
199
200 if (handle == NULL) /* check handle */
201 {
202 return 2; /* return error */
203 }
204 if (handle->inited != 1) /* check handle initialization */
205 {
206 return 3; /* return error */
207 }
208
209 conf = 0x0000; /* set any value */
210 res = a_wm8978_iic_write(handle, WM8978_REG_SOFTWARE_RESET, conf); /* write config */
211 if (res != 0) /* check error */
212 {
213 handle->debug_print("wm8978: write config failed.\n"); /* write config failed */
214
215 return 1; /* return error */
216 }
217 handle->delay_ms(100); /* delay 100ms */
218 for (i = 0; i < 58; i++) /* set all */
219 {
220 handle->reg[i] = gsc_wm8978_init_reg[i]; /* save regs */
221 }
222
223 return 0; /* success return 0 */
224}

9377uint8_t wm8978_init(wm8978_handle_t *handle)
9378{
9379 uint8_t res;
9380 uint8_t i;
9381 uint16_t conf;
9382
9383 if (handle == NULL) /* check handle */
9384 {
9385 return 2; /* return error */
9386 }
9387 if (handle->debug_print == NULL) /* check debug_print */
9388 {
9389 return 3; /* return error */
9390 }
9391 if (handle->iic_init == NULL) /* check iic_init */
9392 {
9393 handle->debug_print("wm8978: iic_init is null.\n"); /* iic_init is null */
9394
9395 return 3; /* return error */
9396 }
9397 if (handle->iic_deinit == NULL) /* check iic_deinit */
9398 {
9399 handle->debug_print("wm8978: iic_deinit is null.\n"); /* iic_deinit is null */
9400
9401 return 3; /* return error */
9402 }
9403 if (handle->iic_write == NULL) /* check iic_write */
9404 {
9405 handle->debug_print("wm8978: iic_write is null.\n"); /* iic_write is null */
9406
9407 return 3; /* return error */
9408 }
9409 if (handle->delay_ms == NULL) /* check delay_ms */
9410 {
9411 handle->debug_print("wm8978: delay_ms is null.\n"); /* delay_ms is null */
9412
9413 return 3; /* return error */
9414 }
9415
9416 if (handle->iic_init() != 0) /* iic init */
9417 {
9418 handle->debug_print("wm8978: iic init failed.\n"); /* iic init failed */
9419
9420 return 1; /* return error */
9421 }
9422 conf = 0x0000; /* set any value */
9423 res = a_wm8978_iic_write(handle, WM8978_REG_SOFTWARE_RESET, conf); /* write config */
9424 if (res != 0) /* check error */
9425 {
9426 handle->debug_print("wm8978: write config failed.\n"); /* write config failed */
9427 (void)handle->iic_deinit(); /* iic deinit */
9428
9429 return 4; /* return error */
9430 }
9431 handle->delay_ms(100); /* delay 100ms */
9432 for (i = 0; i < 58; i++) /* set all */
9433 {
9434 handle->reg[i] = gsc_wm8978_init_reg[i]; /* save regs */
9435 }
9436 handle->inited = 1; /* flag inited */
9437
9438 return 0; /* success return 0 */
9439}

9452uint8_t wm8978_deinit(wm8978_handle_t *handle)
9453{
9454 uint8_t res;
9455 uint16_t conf;
9456
9457 if (handle == NULL) /* check handle */
9458 {
9459 return 2; /* return error */
9460 }
9461 if (handle->inited != 1) /* check handle initialization */
9462 {
9463 return 3; /* return error */
9464 }
9465
9466 res = a_wm8978_iic_read(handle, WM8978_REG_POWER_MANAGE_2, &conf); /* read config */
9467 if (res != 0) /* check error */
9468 {
9469 handle->debug_print("wm8978: read config failed.\n"); /* read config failed */
9470
9471 return 4; /* return error */
9472 }
9473 conf &= ~(1 << 6); /* clear config */
9474 conf |= 1 << 6; /* set bool */
9475 res = a_wm8978_iic_write(handle, WM8978_REG_POWER_MANAGE_2, conf); /* write config */
9476 if (res != 0) /* check error */
9477 {
9478 handle->debug_print("wm8978: write config failed.\n"); /* write config failed */
9479
9480 return 4; /* return error */
9481 }
9482 res = handle->iic_deinit(); /* close iic */
9483 if (res != 0) /* check the result */
9484 {
9485 handle->debug_print("wm8978: iic deinit failed.\n"); /* iic deinit failed */
9486
9487 return 1; /* return error */
9488 }
9489 handle->inited = 0; /* flag close */
9490
9491 return 0; /* success return 0 */
9492}

9528uint8_t wm8978_info(wm8978_info_t *info)
9529{

9531 {
9532 return 2; /* return error */
9533 }
9534
9535 memset(info, 0, sizeof(wm8978_info_t)); /* initialize wm8978 info structure */
9536 strncpy(info->chip_name, CHIP_NAME, 32); /* copy chip name */
9537 strncpy(info->manufacturer_name, MANUFACTURER_NAME, 32); /* copy manufacturer name */
9538 strncpy(info->interface, "IIC IIS", 8); /* copy interface name */
9539 info->supply_voltage_min_v = SUPPLY_VOLTAGE_MIN; /* set minimal supply voltage */
9540 info->supply_voltage_max_v = SUPPLY_VOLTAGE_MAX; /* set maximum supply voltage */
9541 info->max_current_ma = MAX_CURRENT; /* set maximum current */
9542 info->temperature_max = TEMPERATURE_MAX; /* set minimal temperature */
9543 info->temperature_min = TEMPERATURE_MIN; /* set maximum temperature */
9544 info->driver_version = DRIVER_VERSION; /* set driver version */
9545
9546 return 0; /* success return 0 */
9547}
